text:
By Source Staff ,
4 hours ago In Maury County at 7:00 PM, the current temperature is 84.4°F with a light wind from the southeast at 5.2 mph. There has been no precipitation recorded today, and conditions remain clear.
Earlier today, temperatures reached a high of 89.8°F and dipped to a low of 66°F. Tonight, temperatures are expected to cool to around 76.5°F, with wind speeds increasing slightly to 5.4 mph. The chance of precipitation remains low at 3%, and clear skies are anticipated throughout the night.
There are no official weather warnings in effect for Maury County at this time. Conditions are stable, and residents can expect a pleasant evening ahead.
